QuestInfo.0: Training Instructor Kiku is ready to give you the details about your first training session.
QuestInfo.1: Training Instructor Kiku wants you to eliminate #b#e20 Green Mushrooms#k#n in #bRecruit Training Grounds 1#k.\n#bRecruit Training Grounds 1#k can be entered from the #bEntrance to the Drill Hall#k. Might be smart to locate that first.

yes.0: I'm still working on the schedule. Come back later.
